Curious.text: It has stopped to inspect a beetle carrying something much too large.
It is peeking into a flower as if someone tiny lives inside.
It is watching a snail cross the ground like it is the most important parade.

Shy.text: It is pretending not to notice anyone while peeking at a snail from a distance.
It is hiding slightly behind a leaf and hoping nobody asks it to sing.
It is peeking around a mushroom at a beetle passing by.

Startled.text: It just heard a strange noise in the bushes and is frozen mid-flinch.
It has spotted something unexpected and is staring at a ladybug like it might explode.
It nearly tripped over a tiny pebble and is trying to look dignified.

Proud.text: It is showing a perfect pebble to a mouse as if unveiling a masterpiece.
It is posing like it just won a tiny parade and expects applause.
It is standing very tall while a frog admires its excellent posture.

Sleepy.text: It is trying very hard not to fall asleep while a snail slowly passes by.
It is dozing in the sunshine and slowly sinking toward the ground.
It looks like it just woke up from a nap and forgot where its feet are.

Zippy.text: It looks ready to dash off after a beetle that is already regretting the race.
It is bouncing in place so hard its feet barely remember the ground.
It just spotted a frog hopping away and is absolutely ready to follow.

Nervous.text: It is unsure whether the little beetle is a friend or a very small problem.
It is standing very still so nobody, especially the ladybug, notices it.
It looks like it forgot why it came here and is quietly panicking.

Mischievous.text: It looks like it just stole a shiny button and is hiding it from a frog.
It is sneaking away from a tiny mess while a beetle looks suspicious.
It knows something you do not know and is trying not to smile.

Grumpy.text: It does not approve of the weather and is silently judging a cheerful beetle.
It is annoyed that a ladybug moved its favorite pebble half an inch.
It is glaring at a flower that is being much too cheerful.

Confused.text: It is trying to understand a mysterious footprint while a snail calmly ignores the problem.
It is staring at a beetle upside down and pretending that helps.
It seems to have forgotten where it was going and is blaming the path.

Daydreaming.text: It is imagining a tiny world inside a cloud while a mouse waits patiently.
It is listening to the wind like it is music and swaying very slightly.
It is staring at nothing in particular while a snail passes unnoticed.

Bossy.text: It is giving important instructions to a beetle that did not ask.
It is organizing a very small parade and putting the frog in charge of hopping.
It is telling the flowers exactly where to stand.
